title: Sunshine Market
imageAlt: A colorful busy street market with fruit stalls, students and shoppers
imageDescription: A vibrant outdoor street market on a sunny day. In the foreground, three students Li Wei (14), Sarah (14) and Chen (15) stand at a fruit stall piled with oranges, bananas, dragon fruits and watermelons. Li Wei holds an orange and smiles at Sarah. Behind them, another student Zhang holds a camera near the Sunshine Fruits stall with apples and bananas. The market is crowded with vendors and shoppers, with signs for Fresh Market, Bakery, Fish Market, Clothes, Handicrafts and Toys & Gifts. Colorful flags decorate the street.
